<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**9** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-client.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/frontend/schema-rendering.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/settings-service.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`  _(via alreadyPending (literal, a string literal in actions), error.message (literal, a string literal in actions), notApplied (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via error.message (literal, a string literal in actions))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `da6fc296175d4567f42fe50cdad566dcee34399c` — the merge of head `d854d108bdf7ce0bcbcc456fd8ed980eea437147` into base `60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin da6fc296175d4567f42fe50cdad566dcee34399c && git checkout da6fc296175d4567f42fe50cdad566dcee34399c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be d854d108bdf7ce0bcbcc456fd8ed980eea437147 && git checkout -B drift-repro 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be && git merge --no-ff d854d108bdf7ce0bcbcc456fd8ed980eea437147

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

**L1 first review: ACCEPT** · PR #34647 · card #33187 (ruling A 6915677641) · area o2-B · L1-a2 · 2026-11-17T05:41Z

Head-sha: `82f384a572459b42c1212ba002f663e440b8a6ed`

Final-head comment 6939681115; dev report 6938771548.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`. `Part of #33187`, and the body has no closing keyword. `Part of` is right: the Add User `alreadyPending` half is not delivered and moves to #34651 (open, `finding`, p2). `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and `Skills-docs: follow-up #34648` (open, `domain:skills`). #34651, #34652 and #34648 all exist and match their roles, and no verb sits beside any of them.
- **Scope** (`get_files`, 8 paths, +446/−38): the changeset, `ActionResultDialog.tsx` and its test, `sys-user.object.ts` and `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`, `action.zod.ts` (describe and JSDoc only), `liveness/action.json` and `liveness/state-counts/action.md`. Nothing under `plugin-auth`, `ui/packages/i18n` or `ui/packages/core`, as the order required. Commits: `f85cbaf3`, `ae12b3f4`, `ab02a3e4`, and merge `82f384a5`, whose `git show --remerge-diff` is empty.
- **Renderer against the contract.** I read `ResultField` and the new `TableBlock` and `TableCellValue` against the `resultDialog` renderer-contract JSDoc:
  - `table` draws only an array; any other value draws as `json`, and a missing value is skipped like any other field.
  - The header is the column `label` (inline i18n resolved), else its `path`, in `columns` order.
  - A cell reads `path` in the element. `undefined` and `null` draw nothing. A value that fits the column format draws in it, and anything else draws as compact JSON.
  - An element that is not a plain object draws as compact JSON in the first cell, with the others empty. `[]` draws the header over `table.noRows`.
  - The fit test is now one function, `valueFitsFormat`, shared by fields and cells. Its `code-list` arm requires an array of strings, as the contract says. That is the one behaviour change outside `table`, and the changeset names it.
- **Preflight shares the renderer.** `ActionParamDialog.tsx:144` imports `ResultField` and `:518` draws each `preflight.fields` row through it, passing the row whole. On the result-dialog side, `overlayActionFieldLabels` (`useObjectLabel.ts:261`) spreads each row (`{ ...field, label }`), so `columns` reaches the renderer. No change was needed in either caller, as the body says.
- **i18n.** No new key. `table.noRows` (en.ts:735) and `actions.resultDialog.copyFieldItem` (en.ts:167) already exist in the locale packs.
- **sys_user against the door.** The column paths (`row`, `email`, `ok`, `alreadyPending`, `host.notified`, `host.reason`, `error.message`, `notApplied`, `managerError`) all match `ImportSsoUserRowResult` (`pending-sso-users.ts:593`) and `EnvironmentUserHostOutcome` (`environment-user-host.ts:141`). #34531 merged after this head's main merge. I read the interface on current `origin/main`: it is unchanged, and `git merge-tree` of the head against `origin/main` is clean. `manager` (the linked outcome) has no column. That matches the changeset, which names only "a manager that was not linked".
- **Spec surface.** The diff edits only `describe` and JSDoc text: the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` markers and the "draws its label alone" sentence are removed, `null` is added to the empty-cell rule, and "object" becomes "plain object". No key, no format value and no refinement moves. No generated doc carries the changed describe text (`git grep` on the head), so there is nothing to regenerate. No stale "planned" wording about `table` or `columns` is left in `action.zod.ts` or the ledger.
- **Liveness.** `preflight.fields.columns` and its three children go `planned` → `live`, with evidence anchored by symbol. The `resultDialog` note is updated. CI `Spec property liveness` is `success` on this head, and that covers the state-counts freshness leg, so I take the 82/2 counts from the gate, not from my own recount.
- **Changeset** (root `.changeset/`; `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/spec`, all patch). I checked each sentence against the diff: the table rules, the preflight sharing, the `code-list` fit, the per-row Import Users columns, and the spec half. All of them match. The #33186 erratum is correctly not here: that changeset has been released, and the body names the docs-only route on #34651.
- **Pins and ablations.** There are 13 new renderer cases: 11 `table` cases, one of which draws through the preflight panel, and 2 `code-list` cases, one of them a CONTROL. The platform-objects pin holds the column paths and keeps the summary counts as a CONTROL. In `33187-ablation.log`:
  - A1 (table branch removed): 9 failed / 16 passed.
  - A2 (`null` handling removed): 1 failed / 24 passed.
  - A3 (`code-list` fit back to `Array.isArray`): 2 failed / 23 passed.
  - All three were restored to `blob == HEAD` (`eea0d1ad`) with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Gates.** 98 derived, 98 run (`33187-gates-ran.txt`). The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite is a declared NOT MEASURED narrowing. CI carries it: `Test UI` 1–16/16 are all `success` on this head.
- **CI on this head** (check-runs, `filter=latest`, 71 runs): `success=59`, `skipped=12`, nothing red or pending.

### Accepted deviations

- **The alignment pin uses the door's documented row shape, not a real door answer.** The order asked for a real answer. Producing one needs `plugin-auth`, which this run may not edit, and the real-answer pin rides with #34651. I checked the paths against the interface above, so this is not a rework item.
- **Column headers stay English in every locale.** No bundle key exists for a column label. This is filed as #34652 and stated in the body.
- **Cell chrome** (`text` and `code-list` cells have no copy button; `secret` and `qrcode` keep theirs). This is a reading of "a cell draws in its format", and the body puts it to the contract review. L1 has no objection.

### L2 and landing

- **L2 owed at this head:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (published schema `describe`/JSDoc under `packages/spec/src/**`, plus `Clause-②: yes`). Keep `needs:contract-review` until a same-shape PASS at `82f384a5` is on file.
- **Landing tier.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34647` reads `NOT governed`, 484 changed lines ≤ 3000. However, the PR touches `packages/spec/src` outside tests, so it is spec surface and goes to the seat as Tier H, and the area does not land it. Once L1 ACCEPT and an L2 PASS are both on file at this head, the final four steps apply: seat record and 速读, `pm:awaiting-merge`, review request to the approvers, and the round report. ⛔ Do not mark it ready, queue it or arm auto-merge before an approval is on file.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `82f384a572459b42c1212ba002f663e440b8a6ed`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx, packages/spec/liveness/action.json

Inputs read: card #33187 (body and all 13 comments, ruling A 6915677641 and the renderer notes 6934494528 included), PR #34647 (body, its 3 comments, the 8-file list, the net diff against merge-base `8dd8192c`), the 71 check-runs on the head, and the two last contract records on PR #34500 (6932322404 and the delta 6934473605) that set what the renderer owes. Read to judge, not reviewed: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` (`PreflightPanel`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/environment-user-host.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts`. The rest of the diff (`sys-user.object.ts`, the two test files, the changeset body, `liveness/state-counts/action.md`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; what this record says about `sys-user.object.ts` below answers the seat's question and is not a review of it.

Check-runs on the head: 71 runs, none failed, none pending. Completed green, among them: Test Core 1/8 to 8/8 and its aggregate, Test UI 1/16 to 16/16 and its aggregate, Build Core, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace, source gates, consumer gates and debt ledger, Lint and Repo Gates and every Lint shard, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate. Skipped: the opt-in and queue-only jobs, Build Docs, UI Published Artifacts. These are the gate verdicts; the PR body's local runs are not relied on.

### ① Derived judgments

- Spec accept set: unchanged. The whole of the `action.zod.ts` diff is three `.describe()` strings (the column `format`, the row `format`, the row `columns`) and one paragraph of the `table` bullet in the `resultDialog` JSDoc. No schema call, key, enum member, alias map, refinement or refusal message moved: `ACTION_ANSWER_FIELD_FORMATS` is the same six members, `actionAnswerScalarFormat`, `ActionAnswerTableColumnSchema` and `refuseTableColumnContradictions` are byte-identical, and the cell refusal message is untouched. No document changes its parse result. Right.
- The `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker is gone from both describes and the "draws its label alone" sentence is gone; both are now true of the tree (`ResultField` has a `table` branch). The liveness gate reads that marker (`markerStatus`), so removing it and grading the rows `live` belong in one change. Right.
- Liveness: `preflight.fields.columns` and its children `path`, `label`, `format` go `planned` to `live`; the generated count line moves live 79 to 82 and planned 5 to 2 (generated, not reviewed; Spec property liveness, the gate that sums it, is green). The flip is earned under the ledger's rule (`live` means authoring the property changes runtime behaviour, README and `check-liveness.mts`): `columns` is read on every path that draws an answer field. Result dialog: `ActionRunner` hands `action.resultDialog` through whole, `useConsoleActionRuntime` localizes it with `actionResultDialog`, whose `overlayActionFieldLabels` returns each row itself or a spread of it, so `columns` survives; all three mounts of the dialog (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`, `MetadataTypeActions`) are the one `ActionResultDialog` component and reach `ResultField`. Preflight: `PreflightPanel` passes each declared row to the same exported `ResultField`. No second renderer of the block exists in `ui/packages`. The four evidence anchors name symbols that exist at the head. A producer exists (`sys_user.import_sso_users`); the author is the producer, so no `producer` line is owed. Right.
- Console behaviour, `table`: a field that drew its label alone now draws rows. Widening. Right.
- Console behaviour, `code-list` at field level: any array drew as a code list; now only an array of strings does, and any other array draws as `json`. This narrows what the console draws as a code list and is the contract's own fit test ("value must be an array of strings"), asked for by the delta record on #34500 and named in the changeset. No shipped producer answers a non-string array under `code-list`. Right.
- Public type surface: `ResultField`'s prop type widens from `ResultDialogFieldSpec` to that type plus `columns`; nothing removed. `@object-ui/core` is not in the diff (see N2). Right.
- `sys_user.import_sso_users`: one result field changes from `format: 'json'` to `format: 'table'` with nine columns. It parses under the shipped schema (`table` with a non-empty `columns`, cell formats `json`, `code-list` or omitted). Every column path is a member of the door's row answer as the tree declares it (`ImportSsoUserRowResult`: `row`, `email`, `ok`, `alreadyPending`, `notApplied`, `error.message`, `managerError`, and `host.notified` / `host.reason` off `EnvironmentUserHostOutcome`). It changes what one dialog draws and nothing else: no `visible`, `requiresFeature`, permission, target or param moved, so no accept-set and no visibility changes, and nobody sees a field or an action they did not see before.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are on the PR body and in the changeset, line-initial, and match the diff: no key, value or requirement an author can write moved, so the kind is `none` and each moved package takes `patch`. `@objectstack/spec` patch for describe and JSDoc text, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch for a non-protocol console change, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch for one result dialog's drawing. The changeset body's account of the renderer matches the code clause for clause, including the `code-list` sentence. Check Changeset is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Tier: the dev report and the final-head comment ask for a review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. The file list holds `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, a published schema, so the face is schema and this record is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- Open question 1 (Add User `alreadyPending` on an email-only re-add): the dev's reading holds in the tree. The dialog skips only a path that resolves to `undefined`, and a boolean fits no format, so a field on `alreadyPending` would draw `false` on every fresh add, the row ruling A turned down as option C. Not delivering it here is right, and `Part of #33187` is the honest closing word. Which door shape #34651 takes (a key present only on a re-add) is a server-lane design outside this diff; the card stays open until it lands. The ruling's rider (the fix "rides with A") was the decision thread's analysis, not a separate choice of the maintainer, and the PR's maintainer summary tells him it moved.
- Open question 2 (the released #33186 changeset sentence): accepted as argued; a released entry is not corrected from a later changeset, and #34651 carries the fallback.
- Open question 3 (column labels have no bundle key, so the import table's headers are English in every locale): real, declared, filed as #34652. Accepted as a follow-up; the renderer does resolve an inline per-locale `label`, which is all the contract's `I18nLabel` promises.
- Open question 4 (a pin against a real door answer): accepted as a follow-up with #34651. The column paths were checked against the door's declared row type in this review (see ①).
- Deviation, the `null` sentence goes one sentence past the delta's list: judged in ④, accepted.
- Deviation, cell chrome: judged in ④, S1.
- Carried from both #34500 records and still unanswered: the hand-written format list in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` (line 483) names five formats and no `table`. Both records assigned it to the renderer half. It is outside this diff and the PR body names a carrier only for the skills sentence (#34648). Escalated to the seat: name its carrier (#34648 if that card takes docs, else a docs card) before #33187 closes.
- The `sys-user.object.ts` and `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts` edits are in scope of the card, not strays: ruling A ends "the add-person and import answers on `sys_user` use it", claim 6936381848 lists both files, and the ledger's `live` verdict cites this producer. The test file's name says visibility, but the new describe pins the column paths and the field order only; no visibility assertion was added, changed or removed.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, each new or changed sentence against `ActionResultDialog.tsx` at the head:

- Column `format` describe, "a missing or `null` value draws an empty cell": true. `TableCellValue` returns nothing for `undefined` and `null` on its first line, before the format is read, so it holds for every cell format, `json`, `secret`, `qrcode` and `code-list` included. A path through a missing or `null` intermediate resolves to `undefined` in `readPath` and is empty too.
- Row `format` describe, "`table` draws an array as rows and requires `columns`": true (`safeFormat`, `TableBlock`; the requirement is the unchanged refinement).
- Row `columns` describe: true; cells are drawn in `columns` order and never from the element's keys.
- The bullet, "a missing value and a `null` draw an empty cell. A present value draws in the column's `format` when it fits": the fit test is one function, `valueFitsFormat`, shared by the field and the cell, and it is the contract's (`qrcode`, `secret`, `text` a string; `code-list` an array of strings). A misfit and every `json` cell draw through `compactJson`, one line. True.
- The bullet, "an element that is not a plain object (an array, `null` or a scalar)": `isPlainObject` tests exactly that; such a row draws the element once, in the first cell. True, and N3 of the #34500 delta is answered.
- The sentences that did not move but had no renderer until now: header is the label, else the path (true, inline locale maps resolved); `[]` draws the header over an empty-state line (true, the existing `table.noRows` string); a missing field is skipped (true on both paths); a value that is not an array draws as `json` (true).

Question 1, whether the contract should promise the `null` cell. Yes, and it had to. On `main` the bullet says any present value that does not fit draws as compact JSON text, and the #34500 delta read `null` under that sentence as the text `null`. A renderer that draws `null` empty would contradict that sentence unless the contract says so; leaving it unpromised would ship a renderer the contract calls wrong. The promise is true for every format, the wording keeps one reading ("missing and `null` are empty; a present value ..."), and it fits the first consumer, whose rows carry optional members. Two consequences the author should know, both consistent with the text and neither a finding: a `json` cell cannot tell `null` from an absent key, and the rule is the cell's alone (a `null` field value still draws as `json`, and a `null` element draws the text `null` in its first cell, as the bullet says).

Question 2, cell chrome. Not a faithful reading as the contract stands:

S1 (should-fix) — the cell rule says a present value "draws in the column's `format`", and the same docblock defines the formats: `text` is "plain text with copy", `code-list` is "each in a monospace row with per-row copy and a Copy all affordance". The field renderers on `main` draw exactly that (`TextBlock`: monospace block plus copy; `CodeListBlock`: per-row copy plus Copy all). `TableCellValue` draws a `text` cell as a bare span and a `code-list` cell as a list with no copy at all, while `secret` and `qrcode` cells reuse the field blocks whole and keep theirs. So for two of the five cell formats the renderer and the contract disagree on an affordance the contract names, and the split between formats is written nowhere but the renderer's own comment. The reason is sound (several hundred rows with a button in every cell), but an author who declares a `text` column for values the reader must copy (the purpose this dialog states for itself) gets no copy and nothing in the contract tells him to pick `secret`; a second renderer honouring the text would draw the buttons.
